nodes.detail:
Implement capacity-safe join/leave with DB uniqueness and concurrent last-seat handling, organizer roster selection and friendly/rated modes. Retain roster snapshot after membership edits.
Acceptance: Two concurrent last-seat joins yield one winner; duplicate joins do not double count; organizer cannot assign an outsider; 3v3 roster persists after rename.
Proposed package: materialize only after prerequisite acceptance.
nodes.title: V02: Sessions, attendance and fixed match rosters

nodes.detail:
Implement rules/state machine above before UI polish. Add transaction/idempotency tests, dispute/correction UI and full pool replay. Store algorithm version and immutable rating history.
Acceptance: Equal 1000-rated 3v3 winners become 1012 and losers 988; no pending/guest/friendly/disputed match changes Elo; replay after correcting first of three matches matches fresh calculation; double confirmation applies once.
Proposed package: materialize only after prerequisite acceptance.
